about.en: KraneShares China Technology & Semiconductor STAR 50 Index ETF bStock (KSTRB) is a tokenized fund share of the KraneShares China Technology & Semiconductor STAR 50 Index ETF issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain, backed 1:1 by KSTR fund shares held with a regulated custodian and convertible 1:1 into the underlying fund share. bStocks are admitted to trading under prospectuses approved by the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority and are not offered in every jurisdiction.
